segments.text: ¶ Heere (brethren) ye haue a ſhort expoſition of the particular things belonging to our faith. And as touching thoſe things, which ſhall be perceiued of you to want, I beſeech you to allow of theſe excuſes. One is, that my abilitie is but ſmall and ſlender; the other is, for that I meane, in the booke which I haue in hand touching the true worſhipping of God: to ſupplie manie wants, which for breuitie ſake I haue omitted. God and the Father make you partakers more and more of his grace in Chriſt Ieſu our Lord! Amen.
